subject: Bench SDK S5: arms.py — canonical ON-arm + pluggable executor + OFF/RAG
description: bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py — the heart. CANONICAL ON-arm WIRING = port FeatureBench's ClaudeCodeAgent pattern (.venv-fb/Lib/site-packages/featurebench/infer/agents/claude_code.py _setup_zonoid_context): register unit as note/task → GET /search → GET /task/suggest (suggest_links, ceScore>0.2, non-dup) → POST /overlay/edge to WIRE the verified DAG. This is the production pipeline (with suggest_links + cross-encoder) — supersedes agent-memory's judge-all-sessions divergence. PLUGGABLE EXECUTOR: (a) agent_in_container — real Claude Code agent + AGENTS.md preload (verified context) + live /search?task_key= during session (FeatureBench mode, graded by the bench's tests); (b) retrieve_and_answer — read the wired DAG (/task/context or tiered /search) + answer via judge.claude_p, scored vs gold (agent-memory QA mode). Plus OFF-cold (no memory) + RAG-control (/search, no task_key = retrieval-time baseline). Depends on client + judge + workspace. Commit on the attempt branch.

summary: Built bench/zonoid_bench/arms.py (design §5) + bench/zonoid_bench/mcp-off.json on attempt branch orch/attempt/59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b-19 (commit c2882b7, 725 insertions). Canonical ON arm ports FeatureBench ClaudeCodeAgent: run_canonical_wiring = register unit (post_note OR drop_task_stub+post_status) -> client.search(task_summary) -> task_suggest(ceScore) -> overlay_edge(kind="context", from=note->to=unit) for ceScore>0.2 non-dup -> read via get_task_context. Pluggable executor: run_agent_in_container (builds AGENTS.md + verified context for a real agent) + run_retrieve_and_answer (reads wired DAG, answers via judge.claude_p). Contrast arms: run_cold + run_rag_control. Fixed TWO bugs in the FB reference (recorded as note-mqheiw4iv5t): FB's type:"context" is ignored by the daemon (reads b.kind) so it silently makes a blocking edge; and FB wires the edge backwards (from=note,to=node) when /task/context reads it as from=note provider into to=task. Live smoke on embeddable py312 PASSES all 3 assertions (ON answer contains planted fact, wiring surfaces >=1 context edge, cold doesn't contain it). stdlib-only. RECONCILE pluggable-backend: orch/feature/pluggable-backend's lib/llm-backend.js is a DAEMON-SIDE Node LLM-engine adapter (agentic-cli vs api providers, in-process judge loop) — ORTHOGONAL to the SDK's Python arms executor seam (different layer + language); no conflict, no shared seam to build on. Did NOT block/merge it.
